falsification_set: Tool binding: identical established ToolIdentity/version under two aliases returns equivalent; equal executable bytes under unbound identities cannot manufacture equivalence; different build/config bytes alone cannot manufacture non-equivalence.

Tool insufficiency: missing/replaced artifact-to-identity binding, contradictory version binding or revoked evidence prevents the identity relation where the binding is not established. Undisclosed material configuration/dependency or hidden model subordinate blocks the corresponding execution/disclosure standing without manufacturing identity inequality or erasing an otherwise established identity relation.
Human aliasing: two accounts/keys established as one principal return equivalent; different display names, git authors or account IDs alone never yield affirmed non-equivalence.

Human insufficiency: reassigned namespace IDs, missing event-time acting-principal evidence, shared accounts, conflicting alias maps or revoked keys return unresolved where identity cannot be established; a delegated action never silently changes the acting principal.

R13 endpoint binding: substitute a snapshot from another endpoint while keeping the requested model name and otherwise valid capture; it cannot resolve the invocation through that endpoint. Direct invocation spelling-to-EID string comparison must not reject the valid retained endpoint-binding chain.
R13 unknown alias: an undocumented endpoint alias or absent/ambiguous endpoint binding remains undetermined/unresolved, not an accepted normalization or proven-irrelevant exclusion.
R14 contradicted source: add a relevant contradicted capture before and after a clean/corroborated source; the contradiction remains visible and blocks a clean permitting aggregate in either order.
R14 ambiguous source: add a relevant internally ambiguous snapshot before and after clean support; neither order may silently skip ambiguity and resolve positively.

Relevant-source conflicts: provider/corroborated disagreement and two corroborated sources resolving to different identities fail closed in every permutation unless a separately governed conflict rule explicitly resolves the conflict.

Agreement: self_asserted and corroborated sources asserting the same mapping produce identical relation/evidence-threshold findings in every order, with both source classes retained. Both sides of a model comparison must meet the existing threshold; swapping the corroborated side cannot change the requirement.

Irrelevant-source control: demonstrably wrong-endpoint, expired, future or absent-name evidence cannot veto valid applicable support; each exclusion has a retained reason. Potentially relevant malformed evidence or undetermined binding cannot take this exclusion path.

Permutation and duplication: every permutation of each bounded multi-source fixture, repeated source insertion and stable source-ID deduplication leaves the semantic result/reasons invariant. Two different contents using the same source identity must be diagnosed, not collapsed. Swapping comparison arguments preserves the relation while exchanging the corresponding per-side evidence; it cannot turn a one-sided threshold failure into success.

Temporal mode: later import of demonstrably earlier evidence does not alter its availability, while later observation/corroboration cannot be backdated into event-time assessment. Retrospective assessment has its own cutoff and never rewrites the original capture. Test inclusive validity/freshness boundaries and conflicting or unavailable timing evidence.

No evidence laundering: provider_self_report cannot acquire independently_corroborated standing, signature/transport authenticity cannot promote claim content, and tools/humans cannot pass by borrowing model evidence-class labels.

Cross-kind/composite: human-versus-tool or model-versus-tool kind inequality remains unresolved under current semantics; a model-wrapping tool cannot remove its material subordinate invocation from the evidence question.

C3 conflict: a directly dependent or equivalent-identity ancestor blocks; an unresolved identity edge cannot be converted into no conflict. A negative traversal over missing/unconnectable edge classes remains unresolved.

C10 exact coverage: alter verifier code/test/config version, subject output, input digest, execution environment, reviewed property or linked run; a review of the other item cannot satisfy the condition. Missing reviewer identity/independence dimensions or a PASS label alone never raises lineage standing.

Ancestry incompleteness: missing input/output/derivation/subordinate/inherited-state coverage, a forged complete flag, an empty graph and complete synthetic fixtures must not produce positive live qualification or independence.

Authority separation: a resolved non-equivalent pair, a non-blocking identity subcondition, a successful fixture/test/receipt or an accepted technical proposal cannot issue a warrant, qualify a role, activate policy or mutate authorization state.

Mutation discipline: establish a passing baseline for each selected test, remove or reverse the corresponding guard, and require the intended ordinary assertion failure. Collection/import/setup/teardown/runtime/environment errors and timeouts are not caught mutations; retain those diagnostics separately.

R2 source boundary: omit a known applicable adverse capture, narrow the claimed inventory scope, change the policy anchor or set complete=true; none may improve Q_identity. Include a genuine out-of-scope/inapplicable negative control and retain why it is excluded.

R2 endpoint/capture/MID: unsuccessful capture, missing/incorrect snapshot linkage, full-byte digest mismatch, scalar/dangling/wrong-kind MID targets, conflicting bytes under one target ID and unknown release scope cannot clear the identity gate. Preserve catalogue-assertion status separately; valid IDs alone are not binding evidence.

R2 scope/time: null assertion scope follows its frozen interpretation; unsupported non-null scope remains unresolved; invalid intervals have the specified typed outcome. Test 30-day default and configurable/inclusive boundaries, observation/capture/availability order and distinct retrospective cutoff.

R2 witness matrix: neither side, left only, right only and both sides supplied with valid exact witnesses; every witness endpoint/name/target/event/property/digest/verifier/rule/scope mismatch; relevant conflict despite two witnesses; self-labelled corroboration without admitted rule. Only synthetic necessary conditions may succeed; all production positive-gate attempts remain blocked.

R2 legacy and result axes: each public resolver, equivalence/annotation path and Boolean adapter is tested against the same R13/R14/source/witness guards. Non-equivalent R_identity cannot become Q_identity satisfied without its checks or overall Q_C3_C10/authority clearance. An AssessmentResult with validation_status=invalid cannot be consumed as a valid assessment.

R2 C3/C10 precedence: retain violated on a validly established direct/equivalent conflict despite incomplete other coverage; no-conflict-plus-incomplete remains unresolved. Unknown ancestry is not marked shared/self-authored solely because it is unknown. Exact VerificationRun/property mismatch and missing live coverage never raise lineage.

R2 synthetic/rollback boundary: inject established, synthetic or test_mode into a production payload or replay synthetic results through a legacy consumer; no live gate may clear. Disabling a faulty new path must leave explicit refusal, never recover an older R13/R14 permitting path. Even a valid synthetic Q_identity=conditions_satisfied leaves Q_C3_C10 unresolved/violated and the legacy blocks_adjudication adapter true.

rationale: Step 2 supplies scoped execution evidence, not the identity/lineage conditions needed for governed reliance. Step 3 must make those conditions explicit before any authority mechanism or delegation is considered.

The current model helper resolves the first successful snapshot and its retained test demonstrates order dependence. DECISION-20260814-0001 expressly defers multi-source semantics and requires agreement/conflict falsification before corroborating captures can be relied upon.

Source inspection at the recorded baseline shows that catalog resolution requires an endpoint value but does not bind the invocation's endpoint spelling to the snapshot's endpoint identity, and the outer loop can skip failed/ambiguous/contradicted resolutions. R13 and R14 therefore need explicit applicability and aggregation rules, not just additional happy-path fixtures.

ABS-0004 already names tool identity/version equality and human principal equality but gives them distinct verification requirements. Their mechanical implementation needs evidence contracts; importing the model corroboration enum would invent a policy by analogy.

A kind tag, an authenticated account, a content digest or a missing graph path is a narrower observation than executor identity, independence or authority. Separating those conclusions prevents another representation field from being mistaken for an established property.

Small mechanical slices can be specified and later tested without closing GAP-0008 or introducing a universal executor type. Cross-kind semantics and any superclass remain explicit architectural decisions rather than prerequisites assumed for convenience.
risk: A pure identity helper may be mistaken for an adjudicator; a tool digest or human account may be mistaken for established identity; conflicted evidence may disappear through source filtering or ordering; new type labels may launder model-only evidence thresholds; a synthetically complete graph or absent path may be presented as live independence; and proposal acceptance may be mistaken for implementation or autonomy admission. Shared PI/writer account metadata and uncaptured conversational drafting make the identity/ancestry limits concrete.
mitigation: Freeze the three result axes, typed valid/invalid forms, consumer-loaded bounded source anchors, deterministic synthetic profiles and exact witness conditions; preserve every adverse finding and scope limitation. Protect all legacy consumers, keep Q_identity withheld in production and Q_C3_C10 non-positive in every r2 domain, and make the adapter always blocking. Preserve baseline evidence and use explicit positive/negative/mutation oracles. Sequence separate 3A/3B/3C admissions; rollback disables routes or keeps refusal and never restores R13/R14 permitting. D6/D7, GAP-0008 and later live evidence/governance remain unresolved dependencies.
rollback: During admitted 3A, retain governance/history and restrict work to the exact accepted contract plus A1–A4. A failure withdraws reliance while preserving refusal; no rollback can enlarge scope or restore old permitting.

If a later admitted path loses adverse evidence, bypasses a source/binding/witness check or increases standing on unknown evidence, disable reliance and retain typed diagnostics and the offending inputs/results.

Retain a fail-closed refusal shim at every affected public/legacy entry point. A reviewable code revert is allowed only if it cannot reinstate R13/R14 permitting, first-success aggregation or an unchecked adapter; an old accepting implementation is never the rollback target.

Preserve binding assessments, source manifests, prior records, mutation failures and reviews. Revocation/supersession is append-only; never delete or relabel historical evidence to obtain success. Production positive gates stay disabled throughout rollback.
